Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Patterned Throw Pillow - 12 x 24 Inch, Multicolored Red
Colors: Multi
The lush textures and bright colors of this modern throw pillow create a blend of several geometric patterns in shades of red, white, and black, separated by lush, soft, fleece-like dividers. 100% cotton Imported 12"L x 24"W Beautiful pattern is printed on a machine-woven base. The tufted-yarn pattern adds texture and interest. 1 throw pillow Spot clean with a damp cloth, and then allow to air dry. Rather than pulling at any loose threads, please use scissors to trim them.
